verdict.rationale: A CPU vendor could plausibly ship official developer SDKs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents an SDK for the Ryzen 9 9950X3D. The only developer reference is a generic link title, "Learn About Ryzen AI Software For Developers", on the broad Ryzen family page. It does not tie any SDK to this processor or describe what it offers, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
